description:
'''Jerk''' is a [[subgenre]] of [[hip-hop]] that emerged in New York City during the early 2020s. It draws inspiration from the original 2000s wave of [[Jerkin'|jerk rap and street dance culture]].

Notable artists associated with the scene include [[Xaviersobased]], [[Phreshboyswag]], [[Nettspend]], [[Fakemink]], [[Islurwhenitalk]], [[FearDorian]], [[YT (rapper)|YT]], [[EsDeeKid]], [[Yhapojj]] and [[Jim Legxacy]]. The genre achieved success in the United Kingdom, where it helped give rise to the [[UK underground rap|UK underground rap scene]].
